# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech Job for New Adventures](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): Personal reflections on quitting a stable tech job to pursue entrepreneurship and meaningful projects.

## Projects

- [Claude Surf AI Development Tool](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): Opinionated orchestrator for Claude Code that streamlines autonomous software development with integrated agents and workflows.
- [Fantasy IDL Prediction Game](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-fantasy-idl): Live dance competition prediction game with real-time scoring, leaderboards, and technical architecture details.
